messages:
shane_support: FYI customer acme-analytics opened an urgent ticket: sudden spike in cross-region egress and a lot of 401s ~10:12 UTC. They expect traffic to stay in us-west. Can someone take a look? :eyes:
emma_ops: Uploaded the support ticket. Sample req id req_f1a2b3 included. Edge logs show routing decisions to sea-2 and auth-proxy 401s. Egress bytes from sea-2 jumped ~1.8GB in 3m.
priya_sre: Noted. Any recent console or policy edits? I'll grep config history and parser logs.
rafael_prodeng: Pulled customer's failover blob timestamp 2026-02-18T10:11:05Z. Snippet:
```
failover_policy:
  primary:
    - region: us-west
      priority: 0
  auxiliary: [sea-2, eu-1]
  weights: "25,75"
  sticky: "session_pct=25%"
```
Console serializer started wrapping numeric lists as CSV strings in last deploy.
zoe_support: Customer on Dedicated, didn't edit UI. They saw a config save event at 10:10 but deny action.
priya_sre: Our routing parser expects weights as array of ints. Current deserialization uses split on comma then strconv.Atoi; but when weights arrived quoted as a single token we ended up parsing only first number and ignoring rest. Also percent sign in sticky got stripped at the '%' and produced an empty value -> treated as sticky=0. That leads to tie-break behavior favoring auxiliary ordering.
infra-bot: Deploy note: console-ui v1.43.2 rolled at 2026-02-18T09:50Z (YAML->JSON serializer tweak). Rolling an emergency revert for affected customers.
shane_support: Can someone paste a quick curl we can use to repro routing to sea-2 from us-west header? Customer will run it too.
rafael_prodeng: Repro (local):
1) curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <cust-key>" -H "X-Region: us-west" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -D - 
2) Observe response headers: X-Served-Region and status code
Expected X-Served-Region: us-west, 200
Observed X-Served-Region: sea-2, 401 (auth-proxy)
Trace shows router decision: reason="weights_parse_error", primary_index=-1, aux_index=0.
emma_ops: Attached edge excerpt (redacted):
```
2026-02-18T10:12:07Z req_f1a2b3 router decision=failover selected_region=sea-2 reason=weights_parse_error egress_bytes=1843210
```
priya_sre: Short mitigation: push a routing guard to prefer explicit X-Region header if present and treat missing primary as lower priority. Canarying to us-west now. Also opening a parser hotfix.
billing-bot: Created dispute BD-20260218-128 for customer. Flagged for manual refund of sea-2 egress if confirmed.
zoe_support: Draft update to customer ready: "We're investigating a console encoding regression that caused an incorrect failover decision; canary workaround applied to us-west and billing dispute opened. Recommend rotating API keys if they saw auth failures." Approve?
shane_support: LGTM. Add ETA ~2h and note we'll follow up with a full timeline for audit.
infra-bot: Canary rollout to 8 us-west hosts complete. Monitoring: auth_401_rate, route_mismatch_count, egress_by_region.
priya_sre: After canary: auth_401 down 82% for this customer and sample curls now show X-Served-Region: us-west. Proceeding with staged rollout and parser patch PR.
rafael_prodeng: PR ready with unit tests for CSV weights and percent-suffix sticky parsing. Will request review and schedule quick deploy.
shane_support: Please paste final timeline and final egress/billing delta in the ticket once resolved. Close after billing dispute and customer ack. :thumbsup:
